desktop.justification: Kept at spec. Desktop D measurement (Chrome 155 headless, M4 Pro); see docs/validation/interactive-viewer-performance.md.

desktop.justification: Kept at spec; MISS on two counts. (1) Admission: with the 239 MB resident F4 source charged to the D worker pool (512 MiB), sortRowOrder is refused with resource-limit (required 536,871,768 B > 536,870,912 B); no admitted-profile measurement exists. (2) Time: the cited run is UNADMITTED diagnostic timing (resident source not charged), p95 9159.1 ms, >2x the ceiling. The prepared cache also refuses 1M strings. Collation semantics are never relaxed; no loosening without an amendment. Desktop D measurement (Chrome 155 headless, M4 Pro); see docs/validation/interactive-viewer-performance.md.

diagnostics.reason: FALLBACK diagnostic, not threshold evidence: prepareColumns of 8 x 1M columns is refused by the 64 MiB D prepared budget, so this sort reads the source inside the measured operation (key read 4.4 s of the kernel). It measures a different boundary from spec §12.2.
